scope_note: Exact claims replace programme globs. Implement nothing before independent oracle freeze and red commit. Existing broad Stop intent includes edit/continue client registration and accessible overlay Stop; no new create cancellation or server/provider guarantee. Coordinator production baseline confirms missing Stop in isolated edit/continue and covered Stop in supported generate-plus-edit overlap at both widths. Keyboard coverage remains pending. Footer reachability is already proved; chapter-position reset is the confirmed defect.
invariants: Select and Picker stay separate. Prove rendered contextual names rather than treating eight missing explicit ariaLabel props as eight unnamed controls.
Preserve numeric null/partial/clamp/range and search semantics, disabled/hint associations, keyboard/focus and exactly-once callbacks. Inspector pill-to-track is the explicitly ruled restyle.

Preserve dark-neon palette and warm Reader identity. Phone repairs must show complete text and deliberately reachable controls at390x844 and1440x900; DOM presence and automatic scrolling are not geometry proof.

Elapsed time must not invent percentage or completion. Confirmed success retains the2000ms completion delay; refusal and cancellation never announce success. Hidden/unmounted operations cannot fire obsolete completion callbacks.

Existing Stop intent cancels registered edit/continue/generate/retry requests, prevents further automatic writes and rereads confirmed state. Keep concurrency ownership and late-answer suppression; never promise rollback or refunded provider spend. Create has no new cancellation contract.
Reader chapter changes present the beginning of the selected chapter below the header while footer access, fonts/settings, departing-chapter read status and explicit paid intent survive.

Mission cancellation settles only its own pending feedback. Preserve unrelated persistent errors, stack bounds, no-provider fallback, rollback, selected identity and later operations. Long agent/model/provider values are visually accessible without losing desktop density.
Chat uses the ruled SimpleMarkdown with guarded links, exact Copy whitespace and truthful clipboard refusal. Preserve incomplete streaming fences, escaped content and Research renderer.

Retain all stored template icons, separate editor choices and unknown Zap; add missing Bot. Remove only ruled Schedule compact/mode surface and two exact retired tests. Retain other public adapters without measured full-cohort net benefit.

Remove only four ruled unused RGB mirrors and correct three stale comments. Preserve synthetic gate fixtures, retained tokens, durations, spinner/reduced-motion exceptions, all historical identities except the two explicit Schedule retirements, and all T0190 async/cache oracles.
Keep fixed census targets and every adverse receipt. No generated/protected/history rewrite for savings. Max two writers; independent final reviewer authors neither source nor gates.
rollback: Revert each primitive or responsive cohort with its consumers; revert Story lifecycle and feedback changes as coherent interfaces while retaining regression tests. No schema, stored-key or data migration.
verify_line: Independent red-first public-action oracles; exact historical test-name parity except two ruled Schedule retirements. At1440x900/390x844 prove truthful Story progress/refusal/Stop, chapter-start positioning, accessible complete control text, keyboard/touch and responsive states. Preserve current cache/ownership contracts and all retention controls. Measure actual full-cohort net benefit before each fold. Full unchanged ten-stage gate, clean committed causal sweep with restored controls, independent R2 and every hosted job at implementation and closure heads. Account for every owned finding/split/coverage row and uncertainty.
